selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler become sure about after seeing the four truths?
questions.answer: He became sure that Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: How did his faith change after this?
questions.answer: His faith became bright and strong.

questions.question: What words did he say with full strength?
questions.answer: He declared that there is no god but Allah and that Allah has no partner.

questions.question: What four big ideas are named as signs pointing to Allah’s oneness in this passage?
questions.answer: Absolute Divinity, absolute dominical care and rule, perfections that come from unity, and absolute sovereignty.

questions.question: Why does the passage say unity fits with perfections?
questions.answer: Because true perfection grows from oneness, not from sharing rule with others.

questions.question: What does absolute sovereignty do to the idea of partners?
questions.answer: It blocks it and goes against it.

questions.question: What was the result of the traveler’s witnessing in this passage?
questions.answer: He reached clear and certain belief in Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What did the traveler openly affirm about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: Which truth in the summary directly says it requires unity?
questions.answer: The truth of absolute dominical care and rule.

questions.question: Which truth in the summary says partnership cannot exist with it?
questions.answer: Absolute sovereignty.

questions.question: Which truth is connected to the idea that good and complete qualities come from unity?
questions.answer: The truth of perfections.

questions.question: What truth is said to oppose any sharing with Allah?
questions.answer: Absolute sovereignty.

questions.question: What central belief is strengthened at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah alone is truly God.

questions.question: What shows that the traveler’s belief was not weak or doubtful?
questions.answer: He had certainty through clear witnessing and spoke with all his power.

questions.question: Name one of the four truths that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: One is absolute Divinity.

questions.question: Name another of the four truths that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: Another is absolute sovereignty.

questions.question: What does the unity of these acts prove about their Doer?
questions.answer: That the Doer is one and has tremendous power.

questions.question: What does the summary say about absolute sovereignty and Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: It does not allow any partner.

questions.question: After learning from the four truths, what statement of faith did the traveler make?
questions.answer: He testified that only Allah is God and that Allah has no partner.

questions.question: What kind of certainty did he reach?
questions.answer: A certainty based on clear witnessing.

questions.question: What truth of Allah is linked with the idea of being completely God?
questions.answer: The manifestation of absolute Divinity.

questions.question: What truth is said to call for unity?
questions.answer: Absolute dominical rule and care.

questions.question: What truth is said to come out of unity?
questions.answer: Perfections.

questions.question: What important conclusion comes from saying all these deeds are really one deed?
questions.answer: They come from one unique Doer, not many partners.
